description:
Repair what can be repaired and return download links for the print-ready file.

Rebuilds QR codes so they scan, fixes proportions by adding paper rather than
cropping, and returns a PDF the size of the paper (inside a border a home printer can
reach, where the paper is one a home printer takes) plus a PNG and, where it differs,
an edge-to-edge PDF for print shops. For small pieces such as business cards and
invitations it also returns letter and A4 sheets with several copies and cut marks.
Links last 30 minutes. Resolution is never faked:
when that is the problem the result carries the prompt to regenerate with.

`qr_url` is the link a QR code should carry when the one on the artwork was drawn by
an image model and decodes to nothing.
name: fix_print_file
title: Fix a file for printing
